about: Hand classifications behind docs/papers/harbour/coherence-as-it-grows.md, at d61903f3 (2026-10-07). One reader (the author), classes fixed before reading.

classes.T: live twin: a second site holding the same rule, list, constant or algorithm that the comment says must be kept in sync by hand
classes.S: single-source claim: the comment declares this site the one authority (often the residue of a consolidation)
classes.H: historical: refers to a duplicate that no longer exists
classes.P: preservation: must stay byte-identical across a change; not a second site
classes.O: other: runtime data copying, an analogy (same shape as), or same-object state
